say:2:1530307001:1.text: Nothing grows here! Nothing at all!
say:2:1530307001:1.source_cn: 种不出来！什么都种不出来！
say:2:1530307001:1.male: Nothing grows here! Nothing at all!
say:2:1530307001:1.female: Nothing grows here! Nothing at all!

say:3:1530307002:1.text: We've tried every crop we know, but nothing grows. The soil must've lost all its nutrients!
say:3:1530307002:1.source_cn: 我们什么作物都试了，可是就是什么也不长！田里的养分肯定...
say:3:1530307002:1.male: We've tried every crop we know, but nothing grows. The soil must've lost all its nutrients!
say:3:1530307002:1.female: We've tried every crop we know, but nothing grows. The soil must've lost all its nutrients!

say:4:1530307003:1.text: But it wasn't always like this. We've got to find a way to bring the land back to life.
say:4:1530307003:1.source_cn: 但这些田地以前不是这样的。我们得想想办法，让它重新肥沃起来。
say:4:1530307003:1.male: But it wasn't always like this. We've got to find a way to bring the land back to life.
say:4:1530307003:1.female: But it wasn't always like this. We've got to find a way to bring the land back to life.
